references.text: The introduction to the inheritance of the tribe of Gad, which this verse concludes the description of
The tribe of Gad built cities on the east side of the Jordan, which are the same cities mentioned as their inheritance
Moses gave the land to the tribe of Gad as an inheritance on the east side of the Jordan
The tribe of Gad returned to their inherited land in Gilead that the Lord had given them
The tribe of Gad asked for the land east of the Jordan as their inheritance because of the good grazing land
